rationale: Teams have visible and secret modes. Every organization member may view and mention visible teams; secret teams are visible only to their members and organization owners, but mentioning a secret team exposes its name in the mention text. Secret teams may have neither a parent nor child teams. Nonmembers cannot view teams. Visibility is not public visibility or a complete confidentiality guarantee, and no setting, team census, mention behavior or effective membership was verified; linked mention syntax remains separate review work.
